Hi Kevin,

Please try to use imporance or varImpPlot.



# title: random forest importance variables
# date: 2017.5.29

library(randomForest)
test <- read.table("test.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
test1 <- subset(test, select= c(Name, Sex, Age, Weight, Oxy, Runtime))

n <- nrow(test1)
set.seed(1117)
newtest1 <- test1[sample(n),]
t_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = round(0.7 * n))
traindata <- newtest1[t_idx,]
testdata <- newtest1[-t_idx,]

randomforestM <- randomForest(Runtime ~ ., data=traindata, ntree=100, proximity=TRUE)
round(importance(randomforestM), 2) # the results are Name and Oxy
varImpPlot(randomforestM) # same as importance function
# end
